description: This file defines the Tag class, representing a tag entity used in the application. It includes properties such as id, name, color, createdAt, and updatedAt, along with methods for copying, JSON serialization/deserialization, and internal timestamp conversion.

classes.name: Tag
classes.description: An immutable class representing a tag with properties like id, name, color, creation, and update timestamps. Provides methods for copying and JSON conversion.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Tag instance with optional new values for fields.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a Tag instance from a JSON map, requiring an explicit id.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the Tag instance into a JSON map suitable for Firestore storage.
